causal_cutoff: completed signal session T; never reads T+1
candidate_universe: active qualified candidates competing in the same admission event

relative_demand_20d_pct.missing: NOT_AVAILABLE if either series lacks 21 completed observations
relative_demand_20d_pct.rationale: direct medium-horizon demand versus the frozen NIFTY 500 benchmark

volume_ratio_20d.missing: NOT_AVAILABLE if the prior-volume mean is unavailable or non-positive

close_location_value.missing: NOT_AVAILABLE for a zero/invalid session range

ema20_extension_pct.rationale: direct canonical medium-horizon trend measure; not a composite or proxy
